purpose: Turn the alpha API contract pack into concrete backend route files, controllers, services, validators, middleware, route tests, folders, and implementation slices for the first private backend repo.

routeFiles.responsibility: Health route, request id, middleware chain, error shape, and route registration.
Request id, actor shell, tenant shell, logger scope, and response timing.
Company scope resolution, cross-tenant block, safe 404 shape, and audit hook.
Role, section grant, commercial vault, membership admin-only, and inactive-user checks.
Login, reset request, current user, logout, inactive block, and session audit.
Admin-only user list, create user, role update, section access, and preview payload.
List, create, update, notes, filters, export, and client memory for tracker-safe rows.
Value, agreement, LOA, negotiation, forecast, contract facts, and redaction denial tests.
Dry run, staging rows, quarantine, duplicate decisions, commit, rollback, and reconciliation.
USD checkout session, invoice state, webhook signature, seat sync, and access lock.
UAT item capture, owner workflow, retest state, attachments, decisions, and sponsor export.
Admin event register, filters, exports, retention proof, and denied-route evidence.

serviceBoundaries.scope: Users, sessions, password reset shell, inactive-user behavior, and access snapshots.
Tracker-safe tenders, EOIs, projects, notes, filters, status moves, CSV redaction, and client memory.
Restricted commercial facts, negotiation rounds, agreements, LOA, forecast, and contract handoff.
Source batch, dry-run, staging rows, validation, quarantine, duplicate decisions, commit, and rollback.
USD plan preview, checkout, invoice, webhook, subscription, seat sync, and access lock.
Pilot feedback sessions, UAT items, owner actions, retest states, attachments, and sponsor exports.
Append-only events, route denial proof, export pages, retention checks, and release evidence.
Management pack, review brief, command metrics, redaction-safe report export, and sponsor summaries.

routeTestMatrix: Auth smoke: login, me, inactive block, failed login audit, reset request safety.
Tenant isolation: every route rejects cross-tenant identifiers with safe response shape.
Access sections: admin, operations, management, viewer, inactive, and system contexts match access grants.
Records redaction: tracker routes exclude value, agreement, invoice, LOA, and negotiation fields.
Commercial guard: commercial endpoints audit allowed and denied access.
Import safety: dry-run, staging, commit, rollback, and reconciliation preserve counts.
Billing safety: webhook signature, idempotency, invoice lifecycle, seat sync, and lock rules stay test-mode.
Audit evidence: every sensitive allowed or denied route writes an event.

folderMap.rule: Thin request and response route files; no business rules hidden inside handlers.
Translate validated request into service calls and response envelopes.
Tenant-scoped business rules, commercial split, import operations, billing state, and audit writes.
Request validation, response redaction shape, and safe error paths.
Request id, session, tenant, access, commercial guard, audit, and errors.
Contract tests for every endpoint group and role profile.
Seed tenant, users, operational records, commercial vault, imports, audit, and smoke expectations.
API contracts, route skeleton, environment, staging deploy, and release evidence.

nonNegotiableRules: Records routes must never return commercial vault fields.
Commercial routes must require explicit management or commercial access.
Every route must carry server-side tenant scope.
Denied access must write audit evidence.
Billing routes remain USD test-mode until live payment approval.
Import commit must have rollback and reconciliation proof.
Route tests must run against seed fixtures before staging deploy.
Error responses must never reveal tenant existence, secrets, or commercial values.
